sobre-mi.title: About me
sobre-mi.subtitle: Daniel Cobos — Computer systems technician, web developer and digital product creator.
sobre-mi.historia-p1: INFOCOB Computación was born with the goal of providing comprehensive, personalized, on-site IT services, opening its doors on November 12, 2008. With that spirit and commitment, INFOCOB delivers quality and close attention at an affordable price to the city of Talca.
sobre-mi.historia-p2: Throughout our history, we have collaborated on software analysis and programming for specialized clients; creation, design, development and maintenance of websites for companies and individuals; multimedia application development and technical support for users and businesses. Today, we focus on new digital product design, modern web development and artificial intelligence integration.
sobre-mi.mision-desc: To offer an economical and competent alternative in delivering IT and computing solutions, where personalized treatment of the client is the differentiating element.
sobre-mi.vision-desc: To be a competitive and original reference in digital services, expanding the spectrum of design, web development and digital products with ecological and social responsibility.
sobre-mi.valores-desc: Integrity, social responsibility and economy. Offering options, bringing technology closer to people and being customer-oriented.
